headline: Sheinbaum presents Plan México at APEC
summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum held bilateral meetings on Tuesday with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney while presenting the Mexico Plan at APEC.
why: Mexico, Canada and China are major trading partners, and bilateral relations among them affect trade flows and investment decisions across North America and Asia.
original_headline: Sheinbaum presenta el Plan México a la APEC
